propositions: Add `caused_by` as a 7th link relation (directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing, Jira-unmapped) to express bug causation provenance as a first-class graph edge.
The hardcoded non-blocking relations tuple at `src/rebar/graph/_graph.py` line ~204 must include `caused_by` or the relation will incorrectly receive blocking-cycle semantics.
`caused_by` must be added to the `relation` enum in `src/rebar/schemas/common.schema.json` and propagated through schema-driven code generation, link canonical sets, and CLI help/golden snapshots.

The implementation follows the `discovered_from` precedent exactly (directional, non-blocking, Jira-unmapped) so the change is purely additive with no persisted data rewrite and no reducer incompatibility.
A `caused_by` edge does not block dependencies and two-node cycles are allowed; legacy LINK events without `caused_by` continue to reduce without error.
